aftrhrs.enchants.tooltip.hint: Hold Shift for what it does
enchantment.aftrhrs.bountiful.desc: Ripe crops have a 15% chance per level to drop one more of their harvest.
enchantment.aftrhrs.cleave.desc: Axe hits splash 20% of their damage per level onto up to 3 other monsters nearby.
enchantment.aftrhrs.culling.desc: +10% damage per level to targets below 35% health.
enchantment.aftrhrs.deflection.desc: 8% chance per level to deflect an arrow or other projectile that hits you.
enchantment.aftrhrs.driftwalker.desc: Walk on powder snow without sinking, and move 15% faster per level on snow.
enchantment.aftrhrs.giantslayer.desc: +12% damage per level against big foes (40+ max health): bosses, golems, ravagers.
enchantment.aftrhrs.harpoon.desc: Crossbow bolts drag the creature they hit toward you. Never players or bosses.
enchantment.aftrhrs.heavy_haul.desc: Fish you catch run heavier, and trophy fish turn up a little more often.
enchantment.aftrhrs.insight.desc: +50% experience per level from the blocks you mine and the mobs you kill.
enchantment.aftrhrs.leeching.desc: Heals you for 4% of the melee damage you deal per level (up to 2 hearts a hit).
enchantment.aftrhrs.marking.desc: Shot targets glow for 4 seconds per level and take 10% more damage from everyone while marked.
enchantment.aftrhrs.molten_touch.desc: Mined blocks drop already smelted: ores as ingots, sand as glass, logs as charcoal.
enchantment.aftrhrs.nightsight.desc: Night Vision while you stand in the dark.
enchantment.aftrhrs.pack_bond.desc: Your tamed pets within 24 blocks take 15% less damage per level, and slowly heal while you're close.
enchantment.aftrhrs.pocketing.desc: Drops from blocks you mine and mobs you kill go straight into your inventory.
enchantment.aftrhrs.prospector.desc: Mining an ore also mines up to 8 connected ores of the same kind per level. Sneak to mine just one.
enchantment.aftrhrs.replanting.desc: Breaking a ripe crop replants it from its own seeds. Level II harvests the 3x3 around it.
enchantment.aftrhrs.rimebite.desc: Hits frost the target over and slow it. Deals +1 damage per level in cold biomes.
enchantment.aftrhrs.second_wind.desc: Dropping below 3 hearts gives you Regeneration II and Absorption for a moment. Once every 2 minutes.
enchantment.aftrhrs.seeker.desc: Arrows curve toward the nearest monster in front of you.
enchantment.aftrhrs.soulbound.desc: Stays with you when you die: it skips your grave and is back in your inventory when you respawn.
enchantment.aftrhrs.springstep.desc: Jump higher, and fall 1 block further per level before it hurts.
enchantment.aftrhrs.steady_line.desc: Your line holds 15% more tension per level in fish fights.
enchantment.aftrhrs.timberfall.desc: Chopping a log fells the whole natural tree. Sneak to chop one log. Builds are left alone.
enchantment.aftrhrs.treasure_hunter.desc: Digging dirt, sand, gravel, clay and mud sometimes turns up a find: nuggets, bones, sherds, map scraps.
enchantment.aftrhrs.twin_hook.desc: 10% chance per level that a common or uncommon fish comes in as two.
enchantment.aftrhrs.vitality.desc: +1 heart of max health per level.
enchantment.aftrhrs.volley.desc: A fully drawn bow looses two extra arrows. The extras cost nothing and can't be picked up.
enchantment.aftrhrs.weight_curse.desc: You move 5% slower while you wear it.
enchantment.aftrhrs.witching_hour.desc: +1 damage per level at night. Doubled under the Restless Moon.
